scoring_justification: Impossible to recompute DFT/GW from raw artifacts in verifier sandbox; comparing agent-reported numeric values against paper-reported gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for the five Octite SC properties
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 867745725423812911: lattice constant from plane-wave PAW verification (8.674 Å); planar density (0.364 atoms/Å²); relative energy (313 meV/atom); DFT band gap (0.2 eV); GW band gap (1.2 eV). Values match reference solution solve.sh.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and confirmed by reference oracle solve.sh hardcoded outputs.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the source paper’s reported numbers (Fig. 2, text) and proven consistent with the reference solver that writes the same numbers.

outputs.description: JSON file containing the seven computed structural and electronic properties of Octite SC and the embedded ribbon.

output_contract.notes: No gold values or tolerances disclosed. The ribbon planarity deviation and band gap are scored with a threshold to verify planarity and semiconducting character.
